videos.desc: A cartoon girl sits sadly on a boardwalk next to her dropped ice cream cone. Her friend arrives with a fresh ice cream, sits beside her, asks 'Bad day?' and gives her half. They share the ice cream, high-five, cheer up and walk off into the sunset with an arm around each other.
videos.said: Hey! Bad day? The worst. Here. Half for you. You're the best!

videos.desc: On a lantern-lit rooftop at dusk, an animated young woman pulls her friend close and whispers a secret into her ear; the friend gasps, they both press fingers to their lips going shh, then sit side by side acting innocent when a man peeks over and asks what they are doing.
videos.said: Come here. Closer. Really? Shh! What are you two doing?

videos.desc: At a garden table under a lemon tree, a young man whistles and coaches his friend to do it too. Her first tries produce only air, but she keeps puckering her lips and finally gets a real whistle out, and they both cheer.
videos.said: *whistling* Nothing, just air! *whistling* *whistling* That's it, you did it! *whistling*

videos.desc: Seen from above, a young man in swim shorts jumps off a bridge into a green river and drops towards a blue inflatable dinghy where two friends are lying. He hits the water beside them with a big splash and disappears under the surface. He comes up, grabs the side of the dinghy and hauls himself on board. All three end up standing and grappling on the wobbling dinghy, laughing and shoving each other while small motorboats sit moored along the wooded bank.

Two young men stand barefoot on the open tailgate of a van in the desert at sunrise with their fists raised, cheering. The white van drives along a coast road above the ocean. Inside, the van is lined with pale wood and fairy lights, and a black dog in a red bandana lies on a wooden bunk while a hand reaches in to stroke it. At night four friends and the dog sit in camping chairs in a circle around a small fire pit in the sand beside the lit van. Finally the four of them and the dog sit in a row on the tailgate, backs to the camera, watching an orange sunset over the sea.
videos.said: Hey kids, it's your dad here. Been on the road for four years now, living out my childhood dreams. Home isn't a place, it's the people you're with.

videos.desc: In a white kitchen a man in a blue zip sweater and sunglasses holds a large bottle of cola in both hands and shakes it hard, looking at the camera. Filmed from inside the house through a patio door, he goes out into the garden, sets the bottle down carefully on a low brick wall beside a garden shed and walks away. A woman in a turquoise sweatshirt and lilac leggings comes and sits on the wall next to the bottle, picks it up and twists the cap. The cola erupts in a tall brown jet straight up into her face and over her clothes; she jumps up, soaked, and throws her hands in the air.

A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.

On a sunlit cobbled street in Lisbon two teenagers stand face to face with a single ice cream cone between them; he hands it across to her and they slap hands. They then run together along the rails after a yellow tram. The scene cuts to a wooden jetty at sunset where a group of friends dance, then pull into one tight huddle with their arms around each other, silhouetted against the low sun.

A mountain hiking path in clear evening light, with rocky peaks, wildflower meadows and a stone cairn beside the trail. A young woman with a blonde ponytail, in a blue jacket and black leggings, points at a young man with a beard. He wears a rust T-shirt and beige trousers, raises one open hand and gives a guilty, sheepish grin, owning up to something. They both smile, then turn and walk away together along the path. Two backpacks and hiking poles lie by the trail and a marmot sits on a rock.

On a wooden jetty on a calm lake edged by pine forest in golden evening light, a young woman with a dark ponytail, in a yellow crop top and wide white trousers, stands barefoot with her arms stretched out and a huge smile. A young woman with long blonde hair, in a light blue shirt, by a wooden rowing boat, tosses her a coiled rope. The dark-haired woman catches it and eagerly pulls the boat towards the jetty with both hands. The water reflects the trees.
